original.target_description: Experiment 1: time of day (4 PM diurnal peak versus 9 AM diurnal low) by brand (Snickers leader versus Pay Day follower) interaction in candy-bar choice incidence, 2 × 2 mixed ANOVA.

n.sample_role: Business-student participants in Experiment 1; interaction has F(1, 42), consistent with all 44 participants.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported for Experiment 1.
n.location: Printed p. 216 / PDF p. 4, Experiment 1; target test printed p. 217 / PDF p. 5.
n.quote:
Forty-four business students (age range 22–29) volunteered for the
study and were compensated by entry into a drawing for two $25 gift certificates to a local
restaurant.

es.location: Printed p. 217 / PDF p. 5, section 2.3 Results, time-of-day × brand interaction.
es.quote:
This analysis revealed an interaction
between time of day and brand (λ = .46, F(1, 42) = 49.62, p < .01).

p.location: Printed p. 217 / PDF p. 5, section 2.3 Results, same interaction.
p.quote:
This analysis revealed an interaction
between time of day and brand (λ = .46, F(1, 42) = 49.62, p < .01).

notes: Rendered primary PDF p. 5 inspected and interaction numerics verified. Requested mean difference is not printed for the interaction; retain printed λ and F rather than deriving a mean difference. Follow-up brand-specific means/tests are distinct from this interaction. Published article version retained. Original-only target; replication and narrative replication-success verdict unassigned.
